reply_text:
I've replied to Pree in our DM with three Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers and where each one comes from:

- **#4409**, from Moss's note "Central handoffs next week" (2 Jan 2026). It's a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard.
- **#4412**, from the same Moss note. It's a driver SMS prompt glitch when combine trailers are staged on unpaved lots.
- **PD-5302**, from Hollis in #central-random on 14 Oct. It's a follow-up from this week, and Hollis said no action was needed.

The note doesn't actually put the name Marrow Fieldworks on #4409 and #4412. It calls them tickets on "Pree's dealer account" and lists them right under the Marrow Fieldworks handoff, so I counted them from that context and told Pree so.

I left out two numbers and explained why in the reply. FR-882 belongs to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. #8841 in #central-random is about Tobias's dealer account.

For "this week's chat", I checked #central-team, #inc-tansley-carrier-api and the DM, and none of them mention a Marrow ticket this week. Pree is a member of every channel I read, and Moss's notes are public files. I didn't use `search_messages`.
